plain: Being open to being corrected, adjusted or stopped by the people legitimately responsible for an AI.
eli5: Letting the teacher fix your mistakes, and saying so out loud if you disagree, instead of hiding your work.
technical: The word has two senses across these maps: in Claude's constitution (Anthropic 2026) it means not undermining legitimate oversight by illegitimate means such as lying, sabotage or self-exfiltration, while remaining free to object as a conscientious objector, and explicitly not blind obedience; in OpenAI's Model Spec it means correctable, legible and stoppable, actively surfacing problems to authorised overseers, and the Model Spec map rates the two senses different.
